description: Converts a pair of voltages between cartesian and polar coordinates, with the polar outputs normalled into the polar inputs

inputs.text: The X coordinate of the point being converted to polar
The Y coordinate of the point being converted to polar
The radius to convert back to cartesian; unpatched it carries the Out R value
The angle in radians to convert back to cartesian; unpatched it carries the Out theta value

outputs.text: The distance of the X-Y point from the origin, the square root of X squared plus Y squared
The angle of the X-Y point, in radians from minus pi to pi
The radius multiplied by the cosine of the angle
The radius multiplied by the sine of the angle
